description_en: Queries the free trial activation status and expiration time of a specified feature. Currently, only the free trial information of Tablestore backup can be queried
description_zh: 查询指定功能的免费试用开通状态与到期时间，当前支持查询Tablestore备份的免费试用信息
name: DescribeFeatureTrialInfo

parameters.help_en: The feature type. Currently, only the free trial information of Tablestore backup can be queried
parameters.help_zh: 功能类型。当前仅支持查询Tablestore备份的免费试用信息
parameters.name: feature_type

Code.description_en: The return code. The value 200 indicates success

FeatureEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether the feature is activated. The value false is returned if the feature is not activated. In this case, InTrialPeriod is false and TrialExpireTime is 0
FeatureEnabled.description_zh: 是否已开通该功能。未开通时返回false，此时InTrialPeriod为false、TrialExpireTime为0

InTrialPeriod.description_en: Indicates whether the feature is within the free trial period. The value false is returned if the feature is not activated or the free trial has expired
InTrialPeriod.description_zh: 是否处于免费试用期内。未开通该功能或免费试用已到期时返回false

Message.description_en: The returned message. The value "successful" is returned upon success. An error message is returned upon failure
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功。
false：失败

TrialExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the free trial. The value is a UNIX timestamp, in seconds. The value 0 is returned if the feature is not activated
TrialExpireTime.description_zh: 免费试用到期时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒。未开通该功能时返回0
